sections.title: Your Comprehensive Ground Transportation
paragraphs: AB provides end-to-end ground transportation solutions tailored to your needs. Whether you're an individual traveler, a corporate client, or organizing a large event, our comprehensive service covers every aspect of your journey.

With an executive black fleet under 36 months old and professional chauffeurs coordinated via our 24/7 central control room, every journey meets the highest standards of safety, privacy, and punctuality.

sections.title: Your Personal Chauffeur
paragraphs: Every journey with AB includes a dedicated professional chauffeur. Our drivers are more than just transportation providers — they are your personal concierge on the road, ensuring your comfort and safety throughout the journey.

faqs.q: What services are included under ground transportation?
faqs.a: Our ground transportation covers airport transfers, hourly chauffeur hire, city-to-city journeys, corporate employee mobility, event delegate transport, and VIP motorcades.

faqs.q: How does flight tracking work for airport ground transfers?
faqs.a: Our control room tracks incoming flights live. If your flight is delayed or arrives early, your chauffeur's pickup schedule automatically adjusts, with up to 60 minutes complimentary wait time.

faqs.q: Can businesses open a corporate account?
faqs.a: Yes. Corporate accounts receive consolidated monthly invoicing, cost-center allocation, priority dispatch, and dedicated account manager support.
Our fleet includes luxury executive sedans, premium full-size SUVs, and executive vans such as Mercedes S-Class, BMW 7 Series, Cadillac Escalade, and Mercedes V-Class.

content.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
content.description: Direct answers to common questions about our ground transportation and chauffeur services.

items.question: What is included in AB ground transportation services?
items.answer: Our ground transportation covers airport transfers, corporate chauffeur travel, hourly as-directed bookings, intercity journeys, event transportation, and VIP motorcades. All bookings include a professionally vetted chauffeur, flight/traffic tracking, premium amenities, and fuel/tolls.

items.question: How does airport flight tracking work?
items.answer: We monitor commercial and private flights in real time. If your flight is delayed or arrives early, your chauffeur's pickup schedule automatically adjusts, and you receive up to 60 minutes complimentary wait time.

items.question: Can I book long-distance city-to-city travel?
items.answer: Yes, we operate regular intercity routes across Saudi Arabia, UAE, and the wider GCC (such as Riyadh to Dammam, Dubai to Abu Dhabi, and cross-border GCC transfers) with luxury sedans and executive vans.

items.question: How can businesses set up a corporate transportation account?
items.answer: Corporate clients can set up an account with centralized booking, dedicated account managers, customized billing cycles, and consolidated monthly invoices. Contact our team to initiate corporate onboarding.

items.question: What is the cancellation policy for ground transportation?
items.answer: Standard chauffeur bookings can be cancelled or rescheduled up to 12 hours prior to scheduled pickup without charge. For group and event charters, flexible terms are outlined in your service agreement.
